subject: Kickoff — aligning launch window, bridge owners & attendee roles
messages:

Cc: MedLogic IT <it@medlogic.com>

Subject: Re: Scheduling kickoff — MedLogic x Redwood

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier this week. We’re ready to lock in a kickoff date so our ops, security, and product leads can align. Primary goals for the first call:
- Confirm scope and success criteria for the initial 30-day sprint
- Validate network/firewall needs for private deployment
- Identify owners for integration and monitoring

Availability from our side (Pacific):
- Tue 2028-07-20, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2028-07-21, 13:00–15:00
- Thu 2028-07-22, 09:00–11:00

Please share a short agenda and the expected internal attendees from Redwood so we can add the right folks. I’ve cc’d our IT mailbox for any pre-kickoff network questions.

Best,
Alyssa Grant
Director, Product Integrations
MedLogic Health

---

(P.S. we’ll need a calendar invite with a persistent bridge and the prework doc attached if possible.)

Hi Alyssa — thanks, and great to see those windows. We can do Tue 7/20 at 10:00 PT — I’ve proposed 90 minutes to cover the items below. Draft agenda (will attach a PDF after internal confirmation):

1) 10:00 — 10:10: Introductions & success criteria (Mina)
2) 10:10 — 10:30: Implementation overview & timeline (Marcus)
3) 10:30 — 10:50: Network/security checklist (Neha)
4) 10:50 — 11:10: Roles, handoffs & immediate next steps (Mina + Alyssa)
5) 11:10 — 11:25: Q&A and action-item assignment

Internal attendees from Redwood (suggested):
- Mina Haddad — Customer Lead (hosting/ops/contact)
- Marcus Lin — Implementation Engineer (tech lead)
- Neha Kapoor — Security & Compliance (SOC2/network)
- Optional: Solutions SME (will join for module discussion if needed)

I’ll coordinate a persistent Zoom bridge and share the calendar invite and agenda PDF. Marcus — can you confirm you’re OK to lead the implementation overview and take point on the preflight checklist? Neha — please confirm the network checklist callouts we should surface immediately so we can give MedLogic the list in advance.

Mina
Customer Lead | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: (will send agenda & checklist)

> I’ll coordinate a persistent Zoom bridge and share the calendar invite and agenda PDF. Marcus — can you confirm you’re OK to lead the implementation overview and take point on the preflight checklist?

Yes, I can lead the implementation overview. I’ll prepare a concise 15–20 minute walkthrough covering:
- Deployment topology (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private options for MedLogic)
- Expected data flows and where to configure routing
- Typical dev/test mirror strategy for integration
- Key milestones for the first 30 days (env provisioned, smoke tests, API keys, perf checkpoints)

I’ll drop the preflight checklist into the shared Drive folder and highlight any items that will require MedLogic IT actions before the kickoff (ports, IP allowlist, KMS handshake windows).

Also tagging Neha: if there are any specific firewall or logging artifacts we should request in the invite so they show up in the first 24–48h activities, list them here and I’ll include them in the agenda.

— Marcus
Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
